name: acme.sh Open-Source Shell ACME Certificate Automation
free_limit: GPL-3.0 licensed local Unix shell ACME client to issue, renew and install TLS certificates with webroot, standalone and DNS validation; supports DNS provider API integrations and automatic scheduled renewal without a software license fee.
watch_out: Not free domain registration, managed DNS, hosting or a guarantee of free certificates from every CA. Own server and domain validation required; DNS API/provider fees, ACME CA restrictions and infrastructure costs may apply. Manual DNS mode cannot renew unattended; GPL-3.0 conditions apply to redistribution.
